title: Dinotopia painting to be exhibited in Los Angeles
content: "Light on the Water," an important oil painting from Dinotopia,will be part of the show and sale at theGold Medal Exhibition of the California Art Clubstarting this weekend.The painting was published inDinotopia: Journey to ChandaraandColor and Lightand has been exhibited in many museums exhibits around the USA and in Switzerland, France, and England.(Link to step-by-step video on Facebook)The Gold Medal Exhibition takes place at the Natural History Museum in Los Angeles. There are a lot of wonderful paintings in the show, and I'm proud to have my paintings among them.The collector's preview and the artists' gala is Saturday, June 9 and the show opens to the public on June 10.  I won't be able to attend the opening. The show will be up through July 1.-----Gold Medal Exhibition of the California Art Club
